title: Close Staging and Production access-repair execution

phases.objective: Bind access repair to repository-owned grant contracts and close execution with environment-specific trust gates and same-cycle least-privilege readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Staging Recovery access-repair prepare, approve and execute System Tools or the existing Production recovery execution path
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The server resolves the canonical target, grant binding, approved plan and single-use ticket, executes only the fixed grant capability, and reports recovered only after exact same-cycle readback.
steps: Derive the environment-specific grant binding from repository-owned policy.
Reject caller SQL, commands, credentials, target identity, grant hashes and ticket material.
Apply the bounded Staging trust exception or the unchanged Production trust root.
Execute the fixed grant capability through the configured breakglass executor.
Verify required SELECT privileges and forbidden write or grant-option privileges in the same cycle.
assertions: Staging access repair is exposed only when every execution and readback dependency is ready.
Production mutations continue to require assertTrustForMutation and an exact Production deployment identity.
The plan, step, approval, ticket and executor payload share the same server-derived grant binding hash.
Readback failure produces reconciliation_required instead of a recovered result.
This change declares no live Production mutation and includes no credential or secret material.
